body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 896fa495b9fd60411c43b4f5f73f27cde2e0907e -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- The new ortho z row (`crates/ui/src/viewport.rs:1351-1352`) maps view depth d to (near - d)/(near - far): near -> 0, far -> 1, linear, as WebGPU's 0 <= z <= w clip volume wants. I checked the algebra by hand and the pin confirms it. x/y rows, `clip.w == 1` (the #434 laws) and the perspective branch are untouched.
- Picking and projection are consistent. Every consumer of `Camera::mvp` I found (`interact::project_uv`, vertex pick, machined pick, boundary viz, gizmos) uses only clip x, y and w, never clip z, so the depth change cannot move a pick.
- Pins are meaningful: `projection_tests::the_ortho_depth_spans_zero_to_one_between_the_planes` (both planes plus monotonic interior) and `gpu_render::orthographic_paints_the_band_perspective_does` (real render, ortho vs perspective band).
- No snapshot PNG changed; only 3 files touched; no build.rs/.github/scripts/dependency changes. Body ends `Fixes #600` and has a `Changelog:` line.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main, which was already up to date with the PR base; no conflicts)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | builds |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` | 377 passed, 1 failed, 5 ignored |
| `projection_tests` (incl. the new pin) | 7 passed |
| `--test gpu_render` | 10 passed (incl. the new test; a GPU adapter was available here for that suite) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The one failure is the known environmental red on this Mac, unrelated to the PR:
```
egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds: egui headless run failed: No suitable graphics adapter found
```

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `viewport.rs` (1417 lines) and `law_tests.rs` (2087) were already well over the ~400-line guideline; this PR adds only a few lines to each.
- For the maintainer: the same fix was independently prepared as #607 (closed in favour of this PR, which was opened first). Follow-ups #609 (traced stock-sim view casts perspective rays in ortho) and #610 (vertex-pick visibility in ortho) are filed separately and are out of scope here.
- The perspective z row (OpenGL-style) is left as is; the PR body argues it only costs depth precision, which is a fair scoping.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
